token.title: 🔑 Otokeni ya GitHub
token.intro: GitHub oha i nyamukula omaindilo 60 keola koadresa ihai tumu otokeni. Omuti aushe weefoka ou pumbwa lwaapo 32, onghee pemeneno etivali omaindilo otaa pwa. Otokeni ohai yelula ongaba fiyo 5000 keola.
token.step1: Patulula Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, opo nee Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: okaunda koye vene. Expiration: efiku keshe, omuti kau pumbwa sha shi na okukala efimbo lile.
token.step4: Ino kuma epitikilo nande limwe. Ometadata yeerepositori doipafi kai pumbwa nande limwe.
token.step5: Shita, opo nee kopa ongushu {token}. GitHub oha i i ulike lumwe ashike.
token.classic: Otokeni yonale oi longo yo: i shita ino hoolola ongaba nande imwe. Ongaba ya fya ohai lesha natango ouyelele woipafi pongaba yovo va shiivikwa.
token.stays: Ohai kala mobrausa ei koshapi {key} nohai i ashike ku {host}. Nande naini ihai shangwa moadresa, onghee olinka oyo to topola ohai twala etaleko, hoshapi yoye yokuya mo. Okabutoni kopevi lehala lokushanga ohaka dimi po vali pamwe nokashe.
token.persistHow: Tula otokeni mofaila {env} yoseva oyo hai kwata epandja eli, popepi na {port}:
token.proxy: nokui tameka na {make}. Opo nee okontaina ohai shange oshitukulwa sha nginx hashi wedele oshipalanyole {header} ku {path} yoproksi, onghee obrausa ohai ifana ehala layo vene nande naini ihai pewa otokeni. Ehala eli lokushanga otali kana, novaenda aveshe ohava topolelafana omaindilo aa 5000 keola.
fork.refused404: Kape na eendjila domatai: {message}. 404 apa oshi li etai ihali kala po ile ondjila oyo oproksi yoseva ihai twala; ongudu yeefoka pombada oya wana nande ongahelipi.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub ya pwilwa omaindilo eola eli, onghee eendjila domatai kada dulika okushangwa. Ongudu yeefoka pombada oya wana. Wedela otokeni moshitukulwa shoshisefa, ile dima eendjila domatai moshitukulwa shomuholo opo omaindilo a longifwe ashike kongudu.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub ya nyamukula {status} kondjokonona yeekomiti, onghee eendjila domatai kada dulika okushangwa. Ongudu yeefoka pombada oya wana.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Okadidiliko kake na efiku, onghee keshe kamwe ka shaala oka li ka pumbwa eindilo, ndele omaindilo a shaala eola eli ihaa longifwa ko.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, ekende leekomiti noudidiliko wa etwa. Eendjila deefoka da kulupa di dule ekende eli ohadi tulwa ponhulilo yokolumoho.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Patulula orepositori opo u shange eendjila deekomiti nomahanganifo ayo; opo nee omulinga otau finana fiyo kondjokonona oyo.
